title: Bear cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bear cub sitting and waving hello -->
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#C99A6B'/>
  <!-- Left arm (resting) -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='72' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#7A4E24' transform='rotate(15 31 72)'/>
  <!-- Right arm (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='58' rx='7' ry='13' fill='#9B6533' transform='rotate(-25 71 58)'/>
  <!-- Paw pad on waving hand -->
  <circle cx='76' cy='48' r='6' fill='#C99A6B'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='45' r='2' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='44' r='2' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='49' r='2.2' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7A4E24'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#7A4E24'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='9' fill='#7A4E24'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='9' fill='#7A4E24'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='5' fill='#C99A6B'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='28' r='5' fill='#C99A6B'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='22' fill='#A0672F'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#D9B48A'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='38' r='3.5' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2B1A0E'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M46 51 Q50 55 54 51' stroke='#5C3A1A' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='46' r='3' fill='#E88A8A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='46' r='3' fill='#E88A8A' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
